senses.gloss:
अपृक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Unmixed, uncombined.
 m. (-क्तः) (In grammar) an
affix of a single letter.
 E. अ neg. पृक्त combined.

अपृथक् ind. With, together with, collectively.
 E. अ not, पृथक् severally.

अपृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Unasked, unaddressed, not spoken to.
 E. अ neg.
पृष्ट asked.

आपृच्छा f. (-च्छा) Conversation, speaking to or with.
 E. आङ् before
प्रच्छ to ask, अङ् and टाप् affs.
